title: Epstein's eugenics plan to create his own race

tellings.quote:
thing with Epstein was he was obsessed
with eugenics and creating his own race.

plain: Jeffrey Epstein, the financier, was obsessed with eugenics, the idea of breeding people for chosen traits, and wanted to create his own race, with his ranch in New Mexico as part of the picture. A guest named Jay Anderson says this, passing on what he heard from a witness named Juliet Byron. It is told as a clue to what Epstein was really after.
